items.title: The FCC is beginning to block gadgets with ‘foreign surveillance chips’
items.raw_content: On October 13th, Brendan Carr's FCC gave itself a new power - it can block gadgets for containing any computer chip made by any company on its list of potential threats to national security. Today, it's exercising that power for the first time, blocking two gadgets because they contain "foreign surveillance chips," the FCC claims. […]
items.title_zh: FCC 开始封堵搭载“外国监控芯片”的设备
items.summary: The FCC used for the first time a power it granted itself on October 13 to block two gadgets over their inclusion of what it calls 'foreign surveillance chips,' a category covering chips from companies on its national-security threat list.

items.title: Apple must open iPhone to alternative app stores in Australia after Epic Games ruling
items.raw_content: An Australian federal judge has ordered Apple to make sweeping changes to its App Store rules following a years-long antitrust battle with Epic Games. Apple has confirmed that it plans to appeal. Here are the details. more…
items.title_zh: Epic Games 案裁决后，Apple 须在澳大利亚开放 iPhone 第三方应用商店
items.summary: An Australian federal judge ordered Apple to make sweeping changes to its App Store rules after a years-long antitrust battle with Epic Games, and Apple confirmed it plans to appeal.

items.title: France asked ISPs to prepare temporary DNS blocks for major social platforms
items.raw_content: Deux jours avant la manifestation du 24 octobre, le Premier ministre Sébastien Lecornu a demandé à Orange, SFR, Free et Bouygues Telecom de se tenir prêts à couper l’accès à TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat et X. Blast révèle la lettre et le compte rendu de la…
items.title_zh: 法国要求 ISP 为封锁主要社交平台做准备
items.summary: Blast reported that two days before the 24 October protests, Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu asked Orange, SFR, Free and Bouygues Telecom to be ready to temporarily cut access to TikTok, Instagram, Snapchat and X.

items.summary: An Australian federal judge ordered Apple to make sweeping changes to its App Store rules after a years-long antitrust battle with Epic Games, and Apple confirmed it plans to appeal.

items.title: Alternatives to animal testing are finally taking off
items.title_zh: 动物实验替代方案终于开始起步
items.summary: IEEE Spectrum reports that alternatives to animal testing are finally gaining traction, with changing habits described as possibly the hardest engineering challenge of all.

items.title: What Is Gridifcation
items.title_zh: 什么是 Gridification
items.summary: A 50-year comparison of Billboard's top songs traces how recorded music became machine-perfect.

items.title: OpenBSD 8.0
items.title_zh: OpenBSD 8.0 发布
items.summary: OpenBSD 8.0 has been released, and the release page lists the signify public keys for the base, firmware, packages and syspatch sets.

items.title: Using Claude to reduce the attack surface of code
items.title_zh: 用 Claude 缩减代码攻击面
items.summary: Anthropic previewed early data from applying Claude to automated attack-surface analysis and reduction across large open-source codebases, arguing the technique can measurably improve the security of deployed software in the near term.

items.title: Tesla pushes Optimus deliveries to late 2027, says hands still a problem
items.title_zh: Tesla 将 Optimus 交付推迟到 2027 年底，称灵巧手仍是难题
items.summary: Elon Musk said on Tesla's Q3 2026 earnings call that customer deliveries of Optimus will begin around the end of 2027, with the robot's hands, durability and AI still needing work.

items.title: Investor-owned utilities charge 23% more for electricity than public providers
items.title_zh: 投资者拥有的电力公司电价比公共电力公司高 23%
items.summary: Kadoa's analysis of EIA data finds investor-owned utilities charged 23% more for electricity than public providers, with average residential prices up 34% from 2020 to 2025 versus 19% at public utilities.

items.title: America has lost 200k of jobs in media, film and the arts. How much is AI?
items.title_zh: 美国媒体、影视与艺术行业流失 20 万岗位，AI 该负多少责任？
items.summary: An Apricitas analysis examines the loss of roughly 200,000 US jobs in media, film and the arts and asks how much of the decline is attributable to AI.

items.title: Google illegally cut down 250K trees in Finland for data center
items.title_zh: 谷歌为数据中心在芬兰非法砍伐 25 万棵树
items.summary: Finnish authorities stopped work on a Google data center after the company illegally felled 250,000 trees, an act that the New York Post reports drove wolves into a nearby town.

items.title: Show HN: Steal My Bitcoin
items.title_zh: 偷走我的比特币
items.summary: The Steal My Bitcoin challenge has been won, according to its site, which thanks participants for playing.

items.title: A 10-year-old CNN outperforms frontier LLMs for skin cancer diagnosis
items.title_zh: 十年前的 CNN 在皮肤癌诊断上胜过前沿大模型
items.summary: A dermatologist reports that GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 were less accurate at diagnosing skin cancer than expected, and that a 10-year-old CNN outperformed both.

items.title: Moderna and Merck say their mRNA cancer vaccine cut death, recurrence by 42%
items.title_zh: Moderna 与默克的 mRNA 癌症疫苗使死亡和复发减少 42%
items.summary: Moderna and Merck reported that their personalized mRNA cancer vaccine cut death and recurrence of melanoma by 42%, according to top-line results released after the trial had already succeeded.

items.title_zh: fheroes2：《魔法门之英雄无敌 II》引擎重制
items.summary: fheroes2 is an open-source recreation of the Heroes of Might and Magic II game engine.

items.title: DeepSeek launches web search and page-fetching APIs for AI agents
items.title_zh: DeepSeek 面向 AI 智能体推出网页搜索与页面抓取 API
items.summary: DeepSeek launched Search and Fetch APIs, opening its proprietary search engine to developers building AI agents and applications that retrieve information.

items.title: Xiaomi’s SU9 LUX trademark points to possible larger luxury sedan
items.title_zh: 小米注册 SU9 LUX 商标，或指向更大的豪华轿车
items.summary: Xiaomi has registered the “XIAOMI SU9 LUX” trademark for vehicles, adding to reports that it is developing a larger executive sedan.

items.title: China’s Magnetic-Sensor Champion Bets on Robot Joints
items.title_zh: 中国磁传感器龙头押注机器人关节
items.summary: Sinomags, a Chinese magnetic-sensor company, is approaching a Hong Kong IPO while betting on robot joints, according to a TechNode article republished from Jumpstart.

items.title: Can China's Memory Chips Finally Take Off?
items.title_zh: 中国存储真能起飞吗？
items.summary: 虎嗅文章讨论中国存储芯片产业的起飞前景，认为国产厂商已开始拥有自己的筹码。

items.title: Huawei and Shaanxi Telecom Put Dual-Band 32T32R FDD Massive MIMO on High-Speed Rail
items.title_zh: 华为与陕西电信将双频 32T32R FDD Massive MIMO 商用部署到高铁
items.summary: Huawei and China Telecom's Shaanxi branch commercially deployed 1.8 GHz plus 2.1 GHz dual-band 32T32R FDD Massive MIMO on the Xu-Lan and Yinxi high-speed rail lines. The performance figures are company-reported.

items.title: The Codex Team's Post-Mortem: What Worked, What Didn't, and 8 AI-Native Product Rules
items.title_zh: Codex 核心团队万字复盘
items.summary: 虎嗅转载 Z Finance 的报道，梳理 Codex 从云端产品遇冷、转向本地与编辑器插件，再到桌面应用的路径。Every 联合创始人 Dan Shipper 采访了 Codex 负责人 Embiricos、技术负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 和桌面应用负责人 Andrew Ambrosino，讨论 AI 产品应在何时跟上模型能力。

items.title: Xiaomi MiMo-V2.6-Pro Lands on Tencent WorkBuddy and TokenHub With a 1M Context Window
items.title_zh: 小米 MiMo-V2.6-Pro 上线腾讯 WorkBuddy 与 TokenHub，支持 100 万 token 上下文
items.summary: Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.6-Pro is now available inside Tencent's WorkBuddy agent and on Tencent Cloud TokenHub as mimo-v2.6-pro, with a 1M-token context window and OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs.

items.title: Qianjue Unveils Polibrain, a Predictive World Model Built to Run Across Robot Body Types
items.title_zh: Qianjue 发布 Polibrain 预测式世界模型，适配多种机器人本体
items.summary: Qianjue, a developer of robot brains, launched Polibrain, a world model that predicts task-relevant state changes rather than future video frames and is adapted to quadruped, humanoid and wheeled robots.

items.title: Samsung TVs look for microphones in your house via Bluetooth and then spy events
items.title_zh: 三星电视通过蓝牙寻找家中麦克风并推断事件
items.summary: A social-media post claims Samsung TVs scan for microphones in the home over Bluetooth and infer events such as dogs barking or babies crying, and also track activity in YouTube and other apps.

items.title_zh: ELY-Open-Source/ElyOffice：基于 Rust 与 GPUI 的离线优先办公套件
items.summary: ElyOffice is a set of offline-first desktop applications built in Rust with GPUI.

items.title: stackedlol/ascii-sharks
items.title_zh: stackedlol/ascii-sharks：TypeScript 版 ASCII 鲨鱼组件
items.summary: ascii-sharks provides ASCII shark components for TypeScript.

items.title_zh: nthnclrk/CleanFrame：为三星 The Frame 打造的个人主屏
items.summary: CleanFrame is a personal home screen for Samsung's The Frame TV, offered as a starting point to fork and adapt.

items.title_zh: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins — Claude Cowork 知识工作插件集

items.summary: A Swift-based Claude Code skill that turns any SVG into 60 fps animation with live faces, full-body acting and whole scenes, targeting React Native and SwiftUI.

items.title: morganlinton/BeautifulRust: Agent Skills that teach coding agents to write, review, and port idiomatic Rust, plus a tested clippy config. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.
items.title_zh: BeautifulRust：教编码智能体写地道 Rust
items.summary: BeautifulRust is a set of Agent Skills that teach coding agents to write, review and port idiomatic Rust, plus a tested clippy configuration, for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor and Gemini CLI.

items.title: ZiChuanLan/agent-purge: One persona, many coding agents. Replace or inject system prompts across codex, claude, opencode, grok, omp, hermes, pi, zcode - with a local web console.
items.title_zh: agent-purge：统一替换多个编码智能体的系统提示
items.summary: Agent Purge replaces or injects system prompts across coding agents including Codex, Claude, opencode, Grok, omp, Hermes, pi and zcode, managed through a local web console.

items.title: unclebob/ub-mode
items.title_zh: ub-mode 项目
items.summary: GitHub repository unclebob/ub-mode, with 3,888 stars as of 2026-10-25; the source listing does not specify a language or further description.

items.title: AgenticVulHunter: Bringing Local Agentic Vulnerability Hunting to Your Terminal
items.title_zh: AgenticVulHunter：把本地智能体漏洞挖掘带到终端
items.summary: The paper presents AgenticVulHunter, an agentic secure code review tool that runs with a locally deployed open-weight LLM; on 144 SCRBench vulnerability cases it reached 18.4% accuracy with Qwen3-Coder-30B and 23.8% with DeepSeek V3.1 Terminus, versus 17.5% for AgenticSCR using Claude Sonnet 4.

items.title: Deep Search in Real-World Web Environments
items.title_zh: 真实网络环境中的深度搜索
items.summary: The paper introduces OpenDS, a task for evaluating deep-search agents on the live open web, where agents must search, browse and integrate evidence from multiple independent sources to find a unique factual answer.

items.title: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
items.title_zh: WeVisOne-VL：从物体到像素的统一视觉感知
items.summary: WeVisOne-VL is a vision-language model that handles both object-level and pixel-level perception by predicting structured tokens, covering segmentation, matting, OCR, counting, referring localization and detection.

items.title: DStill: Trajectory Consistency Distillation for Accelerated One-Step Drafting in Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding
items.title_zh: DStill：块扩散投机解码中加速单步起草的轨迹一致性蒸馏
items.summary: DStill is a two-stage framework that distills a block-diffusion drafter's multi-step refinement into one-step drafting for speculative decoding. Across reasoning, math and code benchmarks on three model families it improves acceptance length by up to 28% and speedup by up to 25% over one-step DFlash, reaching up to 6.45x over autoregressive decoding.

items.title: Attention-based Classification for Indirect Prompt Injection
items.title_zh: 面向间接提示注入的基于注意力的分类方法
items.summary: The authors evaluate Attention Tracker on the AgentDojo benchmark and find its dataset-agnostic detection claim does not hold in agentic settings; they propose AttnDA, which replaces the scalar threshold with a Fisher linear discriminant classifier over per-head focus scores and improves detection across agentic and tool-integrated benchmarks, though transfer to AgentDojo remains difficult.

items.title: A Sparse Topometric Graph for Scalable Cross-Session Indoor Navigation
items.title_zh: 面向可扩展跨会话室内导航的稀疏拓扑度量图
items.summary: The paper proposes a sparse topometric graph whose nodes encode local 3D geometry and whose edges capture traversable connectivity, matched across sessions by a learned graph-matching network. It reached 77.1% success on Gibson and 40.0% under 3D-FRONT scene changes while cutting memory by more than two orders of magnitude.

items.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
items.title_zh: 感官运动对齐：衡量具身策略成功的柏拉图式代理指标
items.summary: The paper proposes Sensorimotor Alignment (S2), a training-free offline metric measuring how well a model's sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion, and finds it correlates positively with downstream robot task success across embodied model families.

items.title: What Generation Knows: Unlocking Fine-Grained Understanding in Unified Multimodal Models
items.title_zh: 生成知道什么：释放统一多模态模型的细粒度理解
items.summary: The paper analyzes native generation-side representations in unified multimodal models, finding they are more sensitive to fine-grained semantic change and can improve fine-grained visual understanding.

items.title: black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein
items.title_zh: black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein — FLUX.3 图像编辑模型
items.summary: Black Forest Labs' FLUX.3 image-klein, an image-to-image model uploaded Oct 13, has 574 likes and 78,897 downloads. A ComfyUI single-file variant has drawn 1,111 likes and 439,528 downloads.

items.title: google/embeddinggemma-2
items.title_zh: google/embeddinggemma-2 — 多模态嵌入模型
items.summary: Google's EmbeddingGemma 2 is trending with 2,777 likes and 172,474 downloads since its Sep 14 upload. The repo is tagged for multimodal embedding and vision, audio and video feature extraction.

items.title: meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B
items.title_zh: meta-models/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B — Meta 开源 816B 模型
items.summary: Meta's open Muse Spark model is listed at 816B parameters in its repo name and tagged image-text-to-text; it has 613 likes and 2,592 downloads since its Sep 15 upload.
